column3: Close to the Greek; “greatly amazed” is rendered “alarmed.”
NKJV ends the verse at “for they were afraid” and does not include the “shorter ending” (8b) that some critical editions print after it.
NKJV prints verses 9–20 as part of the text without brackets; the critical text includes them but marks them as a later addition.
Close to the Greek; “all the creation” is rendered “every creature.”
NKJV lacks “with their hands,” as does the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
NKJV has “the Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord Jesus.”
NKJV ends with “Amen,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has no “Amen.”
